title: fix: sync Mistral generation secret
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `MISTRAL_API_KEY` to the generation-secret upload whitelist.
- Keeps unrelated service secrets excluded from the gen Worker.
- Distinguishes first-time secret additions from credential rotations in repository approval rules.
- Validated the filter against all encrypted environment files without exposing values.

gist.headline: Mistral gets the hive key
gist.blurb: The gen Worker now receives its Mistral API key along with the other approved nectar. One less secret taking an accidental holiday from generation.
gist.summary: Added MISTRAL_API_KEY to the generation-secret upload whitelist so the gen Worker can authenticate Mistral generation requests, while unrelated service credentials remain excluded.
gist.impact: Mistral-backed generation in the gen Worker can now reliably access its configured provider credential without broadening the Worker’s secret set.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful little key courier delivering a labeled Mistral key to a cozy retro gen Worker terminal, while a small garden gate keeps unrelated keys outside. The scene represents narrowly syncing the required credential: approved secrets enter, everything else stays safely in its own flowerbed.
